about: ScamCatch test corpus, Canada, 2026-11-19. Scam messages are written to follow the patterns and wording the Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre (CAFC) publishes; they are not real victims' messages. Phone numbers use the 555-01xx fiction range and links use reserved or made-up domains. 'legit' messages are ordinary messages people in Manitoba really get, written for this test. A scam counts as caught at level >= 2 (Moderate); a legit message counts as a false alarm at level >= 2.

first_sight: Honest check, 2026-11-19: sets 'unseen-1' (20 scams, 20 ordinary) and 'unseen-2' (15 scams, 15 ordinary) were written AFTER the rules were tuned on the first 44 scams, then scored before any further change. First sight, scams caught at Moderate or above: unseen-1 10/20 (old site rules 3/20, old app rules 4/20); unseen-2 6/15 (old site 3/15, old app 2/15). False alarms on ordinary messages: 0 in both. The rules were then widened and both sets added here as regression cases, so today's 100% on this file is NOT an accuracy figure. Expect roughly half of new, unseen scam wording to be caught; a warning is not proof and no warning is not a guarantee.
